item.text:
I built a **terminal roguelike dungeon crawler** — `dungeon.py` in your workspace.

**What it does:**
- Procedurally generates dungeons with connected rooms, doors, and stairs
- Fog of war with line-of-sight (explored tiles stay dimmed)
- 6 monster types that scale with dungeon depth, with AI chase/attack behavior
- 7 item types: potions, scrolls, weapons, armor, gold — all auto-pickup
- XP leveling system with stat growth
- Color-coded terminal UI with HP bar and HUD

**Controls:**
- `hjkl` / `yubn` — move (Vi-keys + diagonals)
- Arrow keys also work
- `p` — rest (recover a bit of HP)
- `.` — wait a turn
- `q` — quit

**Play it:**
```
python3 /workspace/dungeon.py
```

Descend through floors by finding the `▼` stairs. See how deep you can get!
